yt_title: Lovable vs Stackby for internal apps 👀 #Shorts
yt_description:
Lovable or Stackby? Lovable is great for vibe-coding web apps. For internal apps and AI agents, Stackby gives you a built-in relational database, no-code workflows and AI field agents, with no code to debug and no credit meter.

We compared Lovable Pro with Stackby Economy on databases, apps, workflows, interfaces and AI field agents.

Lovable Pro: $252 a year (~$21/mo billed annually, + cloud usage).
Stackby Economy: $149 a year for 3 users.
That's 41% less.

Feature by feature
• Database — Lovable: Lovable Cloud / Supabase · Stackby: built-in relational database
• Building & changes — Lovable: every prompt spends credits · Stackby: edit visually, no credits
• What you maintain — Lovable: generated code · Stackby: no code to maintain
• Internal AI agents — Lovable: build & host yourself · Stackby: AI field agents in every table
• Automations — Lovable: code or extra tools · Stackby: 1,000 runs / month included
• Apps & portals — Lovable: custom web apps · Stackby: interfaces & portals

Stackby plans (3 users included, billed annually)
• Economy: $149/year (7,000 records per database, 1,000 automation runs/month, interfaces)
• Business: $299/year (50,000 records, 25,000 runs/month, interfaces, sync connectors)
• Pro: $449/year (100,000 records, 100,000 runs/month, interfaces with custom domain, enterprise access)
Every plan includes AI, API columns and interfaces/portals.

👉 Try Stackby free: https://stackby.com/signup

Prices are public list prices at the time of recording, billed annually. Check each vendor's pricing page for current pricing.
